title: Softly Symbolifying Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
abstract: arXiv:2512.07875v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) offer a promising path toward interpretable machine learning: their learnable activations can be studied individually while collectively fitting complex data accurately. In practice, however, trained activations often lack *symbolic fidelity*, learning pathological decompositions with no meaningful correspondence to interpretable forms. We propose Softly Symbolified Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (S2KAN), which integrate symbolic primitives directly into training. Each activation draws from a dictionary of symbolic and dense terms, with learnable gates that sparsify the representation. Crucially, this sparsification is differentiable, enabling end-to-end optimization, and uses an optimization objective inspired by minimum description length. S2KAN can discover interpretable activation functions while retaining dense splines for flexible approximation. We introduce a quantitative measure of symbol

translated_abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）为可解释机器学习提供了一条有前景的路径：其可学习的激活函数可以被单独研究，同时能够共同准确地拟合复杂数据。然而在实践中，训练得到的激活函数往往缺乏*符号保真度*，会学习到与可解释形式没有任何有意义对应关系的病态分解。我们提出软符号化的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（S2KAN），它将符号基元直接集成到训练过程中。每个激活函数从符号项与稠密项组成的字典中提取，并通过可学习的门控机制对表示进行稀疏化。至关重要的是，这种稀疏化是可微分的，能够实现端到端优化，并采用了受最小描述长度启发的优化目标。S2KAN能够在保留稠密样条以实现灵活逼近的同时，发现可解释的激活函数。我们引入了一种对符号……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出软符号化的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（S2KAN），通过将符号基元直接融入训练，利用可微分的门控稀疏化机制与最小描述长度目标，在保留稠密样条灵活逼近能力的同时发现可解释的激活函数。
en_tdlr: Proposes Softly Symbolified Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (S2KAN), which integrate symbolic primitives directly into training via differentiable learnable gates and a minimum description length objective, enabling discovery of interpretable activations while retaining dense splines for flexible approximation.
